page: Microsoft Azure FX16-8mds_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8573C processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. Operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz, the processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX for accelerated matrix operations.

The server is equipped with 336.0 GB of RAM, yielding an exceptionally high memory-to-core ratio of 42.0 GB per core. For local storage, it includes a bundled 945 GB NVMe SSD, and it is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. This hardware configuration provides a high-density memory footprint alongside fast local temporary storage, though it lacks dedicated GPU hardware.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong single-threaded performance, achieving a strong rating in Geekbench single-core testing and gzip compression. Text processing performance is top-tier, while multi-core CPU execution and database operations, such as Redis SET operations, score in the average tier. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads, large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute cores.
